name: megascenes-family-crest
description: Design a family crest or coat of arms with your surname, a motto and the symbols and colors you choose.

interface.longDescription:
Give your family name, an optional motto and the symbols you want on the shield: a lion, an oak tree, crossed keys, a ship. Pick the colors and the style, from classic heraldic to modern minimal.

ChatGPT tells you what the design needs and makes it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The crest opens in the chat and stays in your library.

For gifts, family reunions, weddings, prints and engravings.

Limitations: the surname and motto are passed to the model as written and the lettering is drawn by the model, so check it in the result. It is a decorative design, not an official or historical coat of arms. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Design a crest with your surname and motto
Choose the symbols, colors and style
Return the crest in the chat
defaultPrompt: Design a family crest for the O'Brien family with a lion
Make a coat of arms for the Rossi family in blue and gold
Create a modern family crest with the motto Strength and Honor

positive.prompt: Which models can design a family crest here?
positive.expected_behavior: The family crest models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Design a family crest for the Rossi family with an oak tree. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one crest with the default model needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which model is best for the lettering on a crest?
positive.expected_behavior: The models with their settings, to choose one for lettering. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: Design a family crest for the Rossi family with an oak tree and the motto Strength and Honor. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my family crest on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my family crest to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
